segments.sn35.186:1.1: “Cakkhu, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ atītaṃ … pe … jivhā aniccā atītā … pe … mano anicco atīto.
segments.sn35.186:1.2: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati … pe … jivhāyapi nibbindati … pe … manasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.186:1.3: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.186:1.4: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
